effects: Takes exactly `assets` WBTC from the signer into the vault (ERC4626._deposit safeTransferFrom(_asset, caller, this, assets)); needs a prior WBTC approval.
Mints vault shares (vbgtWBTC) to `receiver`; the number is computed from the vault's rate in storage (floor rounding), with no minimum in calldata.
The vault then supplies the WBTC to Morpho Blue markets (_supplyMorpho); this does not move any other signer asset.
formats.shown: Deposit: 'Deposit asset' with the WBTC amount, a constant 'Share ticker' vbgtWBTC, and 'Send shares to' with the receiver address.

findings.title: deposit: the number of shares received is not shown; the vault rate sets it and calldata has no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.sol deposit: shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Floor). Case 0: 10000000000000 vbgtWBTC in, while the screen only shows 'Share ticker: vbgtWBTC'.
findings.fix: No calldata value carries it. A label such as 'Shares (amount set by vault rate)' could set expectations.

findings.title: deposit: the intent 'Deposit' names neither WBTC nor the vault, and there is no interpolatedIntent.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json deposit intent: "Deposit", no interpolatedIntent. The case 0 reader was unsure which contract receives the WBTC.
findings.fix: Add an interpolatedIntent like 'Deposit {assets} into Gauntlet WBTC vault for {receiver}'.

cases.notes: The screen shows the WBTC amount out (0.00001) correctly. Shares in: the asset and receiver are shown, but the amount is not (it is computed in storage).

effects: Takes WBTC from the signer. The amount is computed from `shares` at the vault rate, rounded up, with no maximum in calldata; only the signer's allowance caps it.
The vault supplies the WBTC to Morpho Blue (_supplyMorpho); no other signer asset moves.
formats.shown: Mint: 'Deposit asset' WBTC (ticker only, no amount), 'Minted shares' with the vbgtWBTC amount, and 'Mint shares to' with the receiver.

findings.title: mint: the WBTC amount taken from the signer is not shown and has no bound in calldata.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.sol mint: assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Ceil); then _deposit transferFrom(caller, assets). Case 1: 1 WBTC unit out of the signer; the screen shows only 'Deposit asset: WBTC'.
findings.fix: ERC-4626 mint has no maxAssets parameter, so no descriptor field can show it. Relabel to say the WBTC amount is set by the vault rate, e.g. 'Pays in WBTC (amount set by vault rate)'.

findings.title: mint: the intent 'Mint' does not say the signer pays WBTC for the shares.
findings.evidence: descriptor.json mint intent: "Mint". The payment appears only as a constant field 'Deposit asset' = WBTC. The case 1 reader was unsure how much WBTC leaves.
findings.fix: Use an intent like 'Deposit WBTC to mint vault shares' and an interpolatedIntent 'Mint {shares} for {receiver}, paying WBTC'.

cases.notes: The signer paid 1 WBTC unit. The screen names WBTC but gives no amount. The shares went to 0xdead, which is shown correctly; that is not a signer effect.

formats.key: withdraw(uint256 assets, address receiver, address owner)
effects: Burns vault shares from `owner`. The number is computed from `assets` at the vault rate, rounded up, with no maximum in calldata.
If the signer is not `owner`, spends `owner`'s share allowance to the signer.
Sends exactly `assets` WBTC from the vault to `receiver`, after withdrawing it from Morpho Blue (_withdrawMorpho).
formats.shown: Withdraw: 'Withdraw exactly' with the WBTC amount, 'To' with the receiver, and 'Owner' with the share owner.

findings.title: withdraw: the number of shares burned is not shown; the vault rate sets it and calldata has no cap.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.sol withdraw: shares = _convertToSharesWithTotals(assets, ..., Ceil); _burn(owner, shares). Case 2: 649721987206 vbgtWBTC out of the signer, not on the screen.
findings.fix: No calldata value carries it. Relabel or add an intent saying vault shares of 'Owner' are burned.

cases.notes: The WBTC in (65 units to the signer) is shown exactly. The burned shares are not shown; the reader inferred shares leave but without the amount.

formats.key: redeem(uint256 shares, address receiver, address owner)
effects: Burns exactly `shares` vault shares from `owner`; if the signer is not `owner`, spends `owner`'s allowance to the signer.
Sends WBTC to `receiver`. The amount is computed from `shares` at the vault rate, rounded down, with no minimum in calldata.
The vault withdraws that WBTC from Morpho Blue (_withdrawMorpho) first.
formats.shown: Redeem: 'Shares to redeem' with the vbgtWBTC amount, 'To' with the receiver, and 'Owner'. Nothing names the asset paid out.

findings.title: redeem: the screen never names WBTC as the asset the receiver gets.
findings.evidence: ERC4626._withdraw: SafeERC20.safeTransfer(_asset, receiver, assets). The descriptor's redeem fields are shares, receiver and owner only, unlike mint, which has a constant 'Deposit asset' field. Case 3: 65 WBTC units in to the signer; the reader wrote 'WBTC assumed from the name'.
findings.fix: Add a constant field 'Receive asset' = $.metadata.constants.underlyingTicker, or an interpolatedIntent 'Redeem {shares} for WBTC to {receiver}'.

findings.title: redeem: the WBTC amount received is not shown; the vault rate sets it and calldata has no minimum.
findings.evidence: MetaMorphoV1_1.sol redeem: assets = _convertToAssetsWithTotals(shares, totalSupply(), lastTotalAssets, Floor). Case 3: 65 WBTC units in, not on the screen.
findings.fix: No calldata value carries it. Labelling the payout 'WBTC (amount set by vault rate)' would set expectations.

cases.notes: The shares out are exact on the screen. The WBTC in has no asset name and no amount; the reader guessed WBTC.
